title: passiflora cumbalensis var. goudotiana
intro: Passiflora cumbalensis var. goudotiana, commonly known as Yellow Granadilla or Passion Fruit, is a type of passionflower plant that is native to South America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its calming effects, and it may also help alleviate symptoms of depression and restlessness. The therapeutic actions of Passiflora cumbalensis var. goudotiana include sedative and anti-anxiety effects, achieved through the interaction of its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and alkaloids, are responsible for its medicinal properties, and further research is needed to fully understand its potential therapeutic applications.
